name: Polaris-Bind
description: Accurate prediction of protein-ligand binding proteins and their binding sites is essential for drug discovery and the identification of druggable regions. Although deep learning has made significant progress in this field, there remains a lack of comprehensive, multi-level benchmark datasets, particularly a unified benchmark for systematic model evaluation. To address this gap, we developed Polaris-Bind, a large-scale, ligand-centric benchmark dataset. Polaris-Bind integrates data from authoritative databases, including UniProt, InterPro, and BioLip, providing both coarse-grained protein function annotations and fine-grained residue-level annotations. The dataset contains protein-level annotations for over $\text{8 0, 0 0 0}$ proteins covering 13 ligand types, as well as binding site prediction data for more than 17,000 proteins with 4.7 million annotated residues across 20 ligand types. For ligand-binding protein classification tasks, the dataset is systematically divided into mixed-species and cross-species subsets. The Polaris-Bind provides a comprehensive performance benchmark for related research. All associated data have been made publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/LrZhang/Polaris-Bind.
reputation: Recently released, publicly hosted on HuggingFace; gaining interest but not yet a long-established community staple.
notes: Large-scale ligand-centric benchmark with cross-species and mixed-species splits. Expect strong class imbalance and some annotation noise from integrated databases (UniProt/InterPro/BioLip). Not experimentally validated binding measurements; designed for ML benchmarking rather than wet-lab confirmation.
